Name: Forager's Nooks and Crannies - New Maps for Stardew Valley
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[size=4][i][size=4][size=5]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/xOnA2oQ.png[/img]
[/size][/size][/i][/size]
[size=4]Adds 10 new maps across Stardew Valley that will appear based on various things to do with your life in the valley, like your foraging skill level, your friendship level with certain npcs and more! Fully configurable with Wildflour's Atelier Goods Forager Pack and more!

These new maps "appear" as you befriend certain villagers and become more skilled in areas like foraging, farming etc. You might see a map one day, but not the next![/size]

[b][u]How to Access the New Maps (Spoilers!)[/u][/b]

[size=4][spoiler]Abandoned Farmhouse - Farming Skill / Friendship Level with Evelyn

Berry Grove - Foraging Skill / Friendship Level with Jas

Frog Hollow - Combat Skill / Friendship Level with Sebastian

Crystal Cave - Mining Skill / Friendship Level with Penny

Mermaid Grotto - Fishing Skill / Friendship Level with Willy

Rainforest Retreat - Fishing Skill / Friendship Level with Leo

Mystical Forest - Foraging Skill / Friendship Level with Leah

Old Growth Forest - Foraging Skill / Friendship Level with Robin

Secret Orchard - Farming Skill / Friendship Level with Gus

Ruins - After CC is complete AND only available if Faerie Garden module is enabled from Forager Pack  [/spoiler][/size]

[b][size=5]How to Configure this Mod:[/size]
[/b]
[size=4]Be sure to[b] install Cauldron [/b]and check out the various configuration settings to decide things like:

[b]Make Locations Always Available [/b]- don't want to worry about befriending NPCs or increasing skills? Can't wait to see these new maps? Enable this and these locations will always be available to you.
[/size][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/cNjfrI3.png[/img][/b]
[size=4]
﻿[/size][size=4]All the translators doing wonderful work to share this mod with other language speakrers: Kedi, Lala92876, Rivieris, Mazout, Soob, Kaen, Souvlakic and voidggukie.

My friends who support me and listen to my ramblings about plants, cats, and mods: I could never have done any of this without y'all and I love y'all so much. <3[/size]
[size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/WrSO1e5.png[/img]
[/size]
[size=4]A few folks have asked and I now have a kofi if you feel like you’d like to contribute towards the mods and me and my kitties.

[url=https://ko-fi.com/wildflourmods]Ko-fi.com/wildflourmods[/url]

It's absolutely [u]not required ever[/u] to enjoy my mod which will always be free for all; but I thank each and every one of you who has donated or will possibly in the future. <3[/size]
[i][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/T0uVb7A.png[/img][/size][/i]

[size=4]This mod is for SDV 1.6 - it is not compatible with older versions of the game. [b]It is untested for mobile or multiplayer.[/b] though if all the same mods are installed, multiplayer should be fine. I cannot troubleshoot mobile; multiplayer your best bet is to try the SDV modded game support discord channel as it is often too hard for me to diagnose the issue across multiplayer saves. 

This mod can be used without any additional crop mods, but you will have more forage show up with various mods installed!
[b]
NEW: thanks to ASLaneZero for posting an SVE compat patch <3 https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33517[/b]
[/size]
